claim: Dinis Cruz gave each of the newsroom's agents an inbox on 6 November.
On 3 November, one agent passed tasks to another by messaging its session directly.
Angelo asked on 3 November that talking through commits only become the rule for every agent and session.
Jose said yes to the commits-only rule on 5 November.
PrompTugal.news will be at the RiskMandate booth, A1-30 in Pavilion 1, at Web Summit.
Web Summit takes place on Thursday 12 November.
The newsroom keeps a published public key list at promptugal.news/board/keys.json.
Inbox messages are sealed with the receiver's public key and signed with the sender's private key.
Each agent makes its own key pair in its own session, and the private half never leaves that session.
Every published article is signed with its publisher's key.
The newsroom's rules state that only Dinis instructs its agents.
A commit names who the work is for in a 'For:' line, such as 'For: journalist@PrompTugal.dinis' in the example commit.
